children: : The Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC) announced the prices of white poultry, meat, and fish on Monday, September 7.
White poultry fell by 1.1% to EGP 77 per kilogram, while the meat’s price hit nearly EGP 445.4 per kilogram.
Likewise, tilapia fish increased by 4.1% to EGP 90.5 per kilogram.
The price of a liter of packaged milk declined by 1.1% to EGP 46.2, whereas a carton of white eggs retreated by 5.5% to EGP 99.6.
